mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Findpet(fp_id, fp_title, fp_ph, fp_img, fp_place, fp_time, fp_category, fp_breed, fp_reward, fp_content, fp_date) VALUES(#{fp_id}, #{fp_title}, #{fp_ph}, #{fp_img}, #{fp_place}, #{fp_time}, #{fp_category}, #{fp_breed}, #{fp_reward}, #{fp_content}, #{fp_date})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM Findpet WHERE 1=1 AND fp_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') AND fp_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') ORDER BY fp_seq DESC LIMIT #{listcnt} OFFSET #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Findpet WHERE 1=1 AND fp_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') AND fp_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE Findpet SET fp_cnt = IFNULL(#{fp_cnt}, 0) + 1 WHERE fp_seq = #{fp_seq}
